signals.title: Interest coverage is thin
signals.detail: EBIT coverage of interest has fallen to the policy floor, so every further rate step or margin slip flows straight into equity value.
signals.recommended_check: Re-test the covenant headroom with the financing bank before the next drawdown.

signals.title: Net leverage above policy
signals.detail: Net debt to annualised EBITDA has moved above the policy ceiling. Deleveraging now depends on an EBITDA recovery rather than on cash generation.
signals.recommended_check: Re-run the debt schedule and confirm the amortisation calendar still matches plan.

signals.title: Operating margin close to break-even
signals.detail: EBIT margin has fallen below the monitoring line. With interest and tax still to be served, the group has very little room for a demand or cost shock.
signals.recommended_check: Split the margin walk into price, mix, material and overhead before the board pack.

signals.title: Operating cash flow is negative
signals.detail: Operating cash flow was negative in 6 of the last 6 months (6 consecutive). The proxy is EBIT + D&A - cash taxes - change in net working capital; the drain is working capital, not accounting losses.
signals.recommended_check: Separate the working-capital drain from the earnings drain before deciding on financing.

signals.title: Receivables collection is slipping
signals.detail: DSO (average receivables basis) is 69.4 days against a policy limit of 60 days. Receivables are financing the customers.
signals.recommended_check: Age the receivables ledger and escalate the oldest overdue accounts.

signals.title: Cash conversion cycle is lengthening
signals.detail: The cycle widened by 43.1 days year-on-year to 104.5 days (DSO + DIO - DPO). Longer collection and higher stock more than offset slower supplier payments.
signals.recommended_check: Decide explicitly which lever to pull: collection, stock cover or supplier terms.

signals.title: Cash balance is eroding
signals.detail: Cash has fallen sharply year-on-year: capex and the working-capital build are consuming the buffer that previously funded operations.
signals.recommended_check: Model the liquidity runway under a no-new-financing assumption.

signals.title: Cash runway covers less than nine months
signals.detail: At the trailing 3-month net burn of 50,624 USD/month, the closing cash balance funds 5.4 months of operations (policy floor 3 months). No new financing is assumed.
signals.recommended_check: Agree the revolver capacity and the trigger point for drawing it.

signals.title: Profit plan is offside
signals.detail: Year-to-date EBIT is 53.3% below plan for 2024, driven by both the volume shortfall and the gross-margin miss.
signals.recommended_check: Rephase discretionary opex and capex to protect the full-year profit number.

signals.title: Gross margin is being compressed
signals.detail: Gross margin has fallen year-on-year as material and wage inflation is not being passed through to price.
signals.recommended_check: Quantify the price increase needed to restore the margin, then test it in the simulator.

signals.title: Revenue is concentrated in non-USD currencies
signals.detail: 100% of trailing twelve-month revenue is booked in local currencies; VND alone is 45%. Translating back to USD adds unhedged volatility on top of the operating result.

supporting.label: Share of revenue in non-USD currencies

signals.recommended_check: Review hedged ratio and the currency of the debt stack.

signals.title: Funding costs remain elevated
signals.detail: The US effective policy rate stands at 4.83% (2024-12-01), -0.5pp versus a year earlier. Floating-rate debt re-prices with it. Values shown are local DEMO fixtures, not live observations.
signals.recommended_check: Refresh the market series and re-test the interest sensitivity in the simulator.

data_gaps: Customer concentration and single-customer dependency are not modelled (no customer-level data).
Covenant headroom is not modelled (no facility agreement terms shipped).
Inventory ageing and obsolescence are not modelled (only aggregate inventory value).
